title: First-time pop-up opens automatically for a new student with no classes
preconditions: Fake signed-in session (test student A, NYU university); mocked Supabase with no enrollments for A; browser localStorage cleared; viewport 1440px
steps: Open the home page (signed-in landing page)
Wait for the page to finish loading
expected: The 'Your subjects this semester' pop-up (dialog) opens automatically without any click; it shows a subject search field, a term selector defaulting to Fall 2026 (current semester), an empty chosen list and a Done button; no page errors in the console

title: No automatic pop-up for a student who already has classes; home page shows that class (not the generic card)
preconditions: Fake signed-in session (test student B); mocked Supabase seeded with one class (CS-GY 6033 'Design and Analysis of Algorithms I') and an enrollment for B, with NO notes, handwriting or visits in it; localStorage cleared; run at 1440px and 390px
steps: Open the home page
Wait 5 seconds after load
Check the home page content
Repeat at 390px
expected: The pop-up does not open by itself; the home page shows B's class with code 'CS-GY 6033', title 'Design and Analysis of Algorithms I' and an Open link to /class/<id>; the generic 'Get started · Open a class to begin / Find a class' card is NOT shown; the small 'My subjects' icon button is visible; at 390px the same holds with no horizontal scroll

title: Closing the pop-up without Done stops it reappearing; icon button remains
preconditions: As TC-01 (no classes, localStorage cleared); pop-up open automatically
steps: Close the pop-up (X button or Escape) without choosing any course
Check the home page
Reload the home page
Navigate to the dashboard and back to the home page
expected: After closing, the home page is usable and a small icon button (e.g. 'Update my subjects') is visible; after reload and after navigating back the pop-up does not open automatically again (dismissal remembered on this device); no classes/enrollments inserted

title: Completion is per user: a different new student on the same device still gets the pop-up
preconditions: Student A has completed/dismissed the pop-up on this browser (TC-03); a second fake session for test student C with no classes
steps: Sign out of A (or swap the fake session) and sign in as C on the same browser
Open the home page
expected: The pop-up opens automatically for C (A's dismissal does not apply to C); switching back to A does not show it automatically

title: Search by subject name shows NYU code and title, sections de-duplicated
preconditions: Pop-up open (TC-01 setup); mocked NYU search returns for 'algorithms': BMIN-GA 1170 'Fundamental Algorithms' and two sections of CS-GY 6033 'Design and Analysis of Algorithms I'
steps: Type 'algorithms' into the subject search field
Wait for results (up to a few seconds)
expected: Within a few seconds the result list shows exactly two entries, each with code and title: 'CS-GY 6033 · Design and Analysis of Algorithms I' and 'BMIN-GA 1170 · Fundamental Algorithms'; CS-GY 6033 appears only once; the server-side mock received term Fall 2026 (srcdb 9999) and keyword 'algorithms'

title: Switching term re-runs the search for the chosen term
preconditions: Pop-up open with 'algorithms' typed (TC-05); term list offers Spring 2027, January 2027, Fall 2026 (current), Summer 2026
steps: Open the term selector and check the options and default
Select Spring 2027
Observe the results and the mocked NYU request
expected: All four terms are listed with Fall 2026 selected by default; after picking Spring 2027 the search is repeated and the mock receives srcdb 1274; results for that term are shown (code + title)

title: No results shows 'No NYU courses found'
preconditions: Pop-up open; mocked NYU search returns an empty results[] for 'zzqx underwater basket'
steps: Type 'zzqx underwater basket' in the search field
Wait for the search to finish
expected: A clear 'No NYU courses found' message is shown; no stale results from a previous search remain; no error toast; Done still works

title: Input shorter than 2 characters is ignored; very long input is limited
preconditions: Pop-up open; NYU mock records every call
steps: Type a single character 'a' and wait 2 seconds
Clear the field (empty) and wait 2 seconds
Type a 300-character string
Type 'al' (2 characters)
expected: For 'a' and empty input no NYU request is made and no results/no-results message is shown (or a hint to type more); the 300-character input is either cut to the field's limit or rejected with a clear message and never sent unbounded to NYU; 'al' triggers a search

title: Pick several courses, remove one from the chosen list, press Done: new classes created and enrolled
preconditions: New student A with no classes, pop-up open, term Fall 2026; mocked Supabase has no class with code CS-GY 6033 or BMIN-GA 1170; NYU mock for CS-GY 6033 includes an instructor, BMIN-GA 1170 has no instructor; a third course from another search (e.g. 'accounting' → ACCT-UB 1 'Principles of Financial Accounting') available
steps: Search 'algorithms' and pick CS-GY 6033 and BMIN-GA 1170
Search 'accounting' and pick ACCT-UB 1
Check the chosen list shows all three with code and title
Remove ACCT-UB 1 from the chosen list
Press Done
Inspect inserts into classes and enrollments
expected: Chosen list shows 3 then 2 items after removal; on Done exactly two classes are inserted: subject 'Design and Analysis of Algorithms I', code 'CS-GY 6033', term 'Fall 2026', professor = NYU instructor; and subject 'Fundamental Algorithms', code 'BMIN-GA 1170', term 'Fall 2026', professor 'TBA'; both with created_by = A and A's university; two enrollments for A; nothing for ACCT-UB 1; a summary confirms the 2 classes added; pop-up closes

title: Existing LectureLoop class with the same code is reused (enroll only, no new class)
preconditions: Mocked Supabase seeded with an existing class code 'CS-GY 6033' (created by another test user) that A is not enrolled in; A has no classes; pop-up open
steps: Search 'algorithms', pick CS-GY 6033
Press Done
Inspect inserts into classes and enrollments
expected: No row inserted into classes; one enrollment inserted for A pointing at the existing class id; summary mentions the class as added/joined

title: Course already in the student's classes is not duplicated
preconditions: A is already enrolled in class CS-GY 6033; open the form from the icon button
steps: Search 'algorithms' and try to pick CS-GY 6033 (and also pick BMIN-GA 1170)
Press Done
Inspect inserts
expected: CS-GY 6033 is shown as already in your classes (not added twice to the chosen list, or skipped on Done); no duplicate class or enrollment for CS-GY 6033; only BMIN-GA 1170 is added; summary reports 1 added and CS-GY 6033 already enrolled/skipped; no error

title: Home page shows both new classes immediately after Done (no reload); generic card gone; dashboard lists them
preconditions: TC-09 just completed on the home page (two new classes CS-GY 6033 and BMIN-GA 1170 added, no notes in them); do not reload
steps: Immediately after Done (summary shown), without reloading, look at the home page
Check each new class entry for code, title and Open link
Click Open on CS-GY 6033, then go back
Reload the home page and check again
Open the dashboard
expected: Right after Done, without a reload, the home page shows both classes: 'CS-GY 6033 · Design and Analysis of Algorithms I' and 'BMIN-GA 1170 · Fundamental Algorithms', each with an Open link; the generic 'Get started · Open a class to begin / Find a class' card is no longer shown; Open goes to /class/<id> of that class; after reload both are still shown and the generic card stays gone; the dashboard lists both

title: Icon button reopens the form showing current classes; remove un-enrolls with confirmation, notes kept
preconditions: A enrolled in CS-GY 6033 and BMIN-GA 1170 (after Done); mocked Supabase has a note by A in BMIN-GA 1170
steps: Reload the home page and confirm no automatic pop-up
Click the small 'Update my subjects' icon button
Check the current classes listed
Click remove on BMIN-GA 1170, read the confirmation, confirm
Search and add one more course (ACCT-UB 1) and press Done
Inspect deletes and the notes table
expected: Form opens listing CS-GY 6033 and BMIN-GA 1170 as current classes; removal asks for confirmation that states notes are kept; after confirming only A's enrollment for BMIN-GA 1170 is deleted (class row and A's notes not deleted); BMIN-GA 1170 disappears from the home/dashboard list; ACCT-UB 1 is added; icon button still present after closing

title: NYU search failure shows a clear message with a link to Add class; home keeps working
preconditions: Pop-up open; NYU mock configured to fail (HTTP 500 / network error)
steps: Type 'algorithms'
Read the message shown
Click the link to add the class manually
Return to the home page and use it (open a class, open the icon button)
expected: A clear message says NYU's class search is unavailable, with a link/button to add the class manually (Dashboard → Add class); the link goes to the dashboard (Add class reachable); no unhandled page errors; home page still loads and works

title: NYU search that hangs times out (~8 s) with a clear message
preconditions: Pop-up open; NYU mock configured to never respond
steps: Type 'algorithms' and start a timer
Wait up to 15 seconds
Close the pop-up and use the home page
expected: A loading state shows first; within roughly 8-10 seconds it is replaced by a clear 'unavailable/too slow' message with the manual Add class link; the page never freezes; closing the pop-up works and the home page stays usable

title: NYU request is server-side only; signed-out call rejected; input limits enforced on the server
preconditions: Browser network capture enabled; pop-up open; NYU mock at the server side records calls
steps: Search 'algorithms' and capture all browser network requests
Confirm no browser request goes to bulletins.nyu.edu (only to LectureLoop's own server function)
Call the search server function directly without a session (signed out / no auth header)
Call it signed in with q of 500+ characters and with an invalid term value
expected: No browser request to bulletins.nyu.edu; the search goes through a LectureLoop server endpoint which calls the (mocked) NYU API; the signed-out call is rejected (401/unauthorized error) and does not reach the NYU mock; oversized q / invalid term are rejected with a validation error (or truncated) and not forwarded unbounded

title: Keyboard-only use of the form; focus returns to 'My subjects' after Escape, X or Done
preconditions: New student with no classes; pop-up open automatically; viewport 1440px
steps: Using only the keyboard: Tab to the search field and type 'algorithms'
Use arrow keys/Tab and Enter to pick CS-GY 6033
Tab to the term selector and change it with the keyboard
Tab to the chosen item's remove control and press Enter, then re-add it
Tab to Done and press Enter; note where focus lands
Tab to the 'My subjects' button and press Enter; press Escape; check document.activeElement
Press Enter on 'My subjects' again; Tab to the X (close) button and press Enter; check document.activeElement
Press Enter on 'My subjects' again; search, pick BMIN-GA 1170, Tab to Done and press Enter; check document.activeElement
expected: Every control is reachable with visible focus; courses can be picked/removed and Done pressed without a mouse; focus stays inside the dialog while open; after the first-time pop-up's Done focus is on the 'My subjects' button or a sensible place on the page (not lost); after opening from 'My subjects', closing with Escape, with X and with Done each returns focus to the 'My subjects' button (document.activeElement is that button, not BODY); the button has an accessible name (e.g. 'My subjects' / 'Update my subjects')

title: Phone width (390px): pop-up, search, chosen list and icon fit without horizontal scroll
preconditions: Viewport 390px; new student with no classes; localStorage cleared
steps: Open the home page and wait for the pop-up
Search 'algorithms', pick both results
Check for horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth vs viewport width)
Press Done, then check the home page and the icon button
expected: Pop-up fits the screen; long titles wrap or truncate; result list, term selector, chosen list and Done button are usable; no horizontal page scroll; icon button visible and tappable on the home page; no page errors

title: Regression: dashboard Enroll in subject and Add class still work; no page errors
preconditions: Signed-in student; mocked Supabase with an existing class to enroll in; console capture on
steps: Open the dashboard, use 'Enroll in subject' to join the existing class
Use 'Add class' to create a class manually (subject, professor, code)
Check inserts and the class list
Review the browser console across all tests on home and dashboard
expected: Enroll inserts one enrollment; Add class inserts the class and enrollment as before; both appear in the list; the dialogs look and behave unchanged; no uncaught errors or React errors in the console on home or dashboard

title: Removing a class in the form updates the home page list without reload
preconditions: Student A enrolled in CS-GY 6033 and BMIN-GA 1170 (no notes); both shown on the home page
steps: Click 'My subjects'
Remove BMIN-GA 1170 and confirm
Close the form (without reloading) and look at the home page
Open 'My subjects' again, remove CS-GY 6033 and confirm, close the form
expected: After the first removal the home page shows only CS-GY 6033 without a reload; only A's enrollment was deleted (class and notes kept); after removing the last class the home page shows the generic 'Open a class to begin' card again, without a reload

title: Student with no classes still sees the 'Open a class to begin' card
preconditions: Student with no enrollments who already dismissed the pop-up on this device (localStorage flag set); 1440px and 390px
steps: Open the home page
Check the home page content at 1440px and 390px
expected: No automatic pop-up; the generic 'Get started · Open a class to begin / Find a class' card is shown and its Find a class link goes to the dashboard; 'My subjects' button visible; no horizontal scroll; no page errors

title: Many classes without activity: home shows at most about 3 recent classes plus a link to the dashboard
preconditions: Student enrolled in 5 classes with no notes/visits (enrolled at different times); a separate run where one class has notes (recent activity)
steps: Open the home page at 1440px and 390px
Count the classes shown and check for a dashboard link
Run with one class having recent notes
expected: Without activity: the most recently added classes (at most about 3) are shown with code, title and Open link, plus a link to the dashboard for the rest; no generic card; no horizontal scroll at 390px. With activity: the 'Continue where you left off' card for that class is shown as before, and the generic card is not shown

title: Unit test: NYU search input schema limits
preconditions: Branch checked out; dependencies installed; unit test for the search input schema present
steps: Run the unit test for the search input schema
Confirm it covers: q of 1 character after trimming, q of 81 characters after trimming, q of spaces only, invalid term id (e.g. 'abc' or empty), and a normal query 'algorithms' with term 9999
expected: The test passes: q shorter than 2 or longer than 80 characters after trimming is rejected, an invalid term id is rejected, and 'algorithms' with a valid term is accepted (with q trimmed); test output saved as evidence
